name: regression: backward fixes still use the off-route check
description: Guards against checking a behind-window candidate before maxOffset, which could accept it as live.

steps.why: The first fix is 500 m along the route.

The only route projection is 300 m, 200 m behind; the forward window is [450, 850], so it finds nothing, while the 25×10 + 100 = 350 m backward limit admits this projection. Its offset is 100 m, greater than maxOffset 60 m, so the off-route check must retain 500 m and report offRoute. A wrong ordering that commits the behind candidate before checking offset would report live at 300 m with offset 100 m.
